CustomField.label: Wartungsvertrag ends in (Tage)
CustomField.description: SCRUM-451: Whole calendar days left on the contract, measured at read. Blank end = blank (never recorded); already expired = blank (never a negative count). System-computed formula field, read-only.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Wartungsvertrag_End__c), null, IF(Wartungsvertrag_End__c >= TODAY(), Wartungsvertrag_End__c - TODAY(), null))
